notes: Focused public C++ TCK contract for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.5 p. 357 l. 67-21. With authorization disabled by a protected RID profile, the TCK supplies HLAplainTextPassword to public Connect and requires Unauthorized. Successful Connect or another exception does not satisfy the case. This contract is bounded to credential-bearing Connect and does not claim full §12.5 conformance.
